units: metres, right-handed, column-major Matrix4, y-up world; contour generator XY plane and local depth +Z

exactBRelations.relation: quartered solid hatch panel bearing against four independently mitered rails

panel.uvPolicy: borrowed geometry UV unchanged; unmapped finish

frame.axisOrder: X across=left of travel, Y source depth +Z, Z along travel

exactBRelations.support: Panel front plane z=0; 1 mm overlap at each edge under the moulding rear bearing. True face/edge surfaces; no coplanar visible duplicate in exposed opening.
exactBRelations.control: render two identical stock coupons at separate placements, manually rotate only pose; center grain remains attached. Panel and rectangular frame share one finish, not one stock coordinate system.

exactBRelations.relation: a steam-bent laminated hoop girdles a matching polygon drum; a separate radial keeper bridges its butt joint

hoop.axisOrder: X across=left of travel, Y source depth +Z, Z along travel

keeper.penetrationIntent: inside edge x=.328, contact with 40-segment hoop outer extent near seam ~.3321 m

exactBRelations.seam: only at neutral station 0/L, under the physical keeper at +X; retained duplicated cell edge. Continuity required at all other rail boundaries.

parameters.otherWorldSeeds: same core hash(sceneSeed XOR 307) as old wood, no new random stream

targetFinish.base: wood unmapped standard or dielectric toon, untouched baseColor/role options; B baseColor=#a88e65, color=#ffffff, roughness .65 PBR. C preserve committed per-slot baseColor.

rig.bounds: actual world box of each fixed relation assembly; same numbers across masks
